# POST /api/v1/user/repos

Create a repository for the authenticated user

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-363`

## Response

**201** — Repository

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | int64 | Repository ID |
| `name` | string | Repository name |
| `full_name` | string | Full name owner/repo |
| `private` | bool | Whether private |

- **400** — Invalid readme template
- **409** — Repository with same name already exists
- **422** — Reserved name or invalid pattern
